title: Toolcall eval harness for selection precision and argument validation
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Goal: Build an automated eval harness that measures tool/function-calling behavior across model/config changes and flags regressions in tool selection accuracy and argument validation. Background: Recent rollouts of model variants and a config tweak to deterministic sampling surfaced inconsistencies where the model either selects an incorrect tool (e.g., 'search' vs 'kb_lookup') or emits malformed arguments for downstream tool runners. Acceptance criteria: 1) Harness can run batched evaluation suites (>=1k cases) against multiple model+config permutations and produce a reproducible report with precision/recall for tool selection and a syntactic+semantic validation score for arguments. 2) Integrate with regression-alerting pipeline so any change to model settings or runtime config that decreases selection precision by >2% or argument validation score by >3% triggers a regression alert. 3) Provide per-prompt failure traces (model output, parsed tool call, validated args, canonical expected tool+args) stored in S3 and surfaced in Console eval dashboard. 4) CI presubmit job that runs a lightweight sample and fails builds for P0 regressions. Scope: harness + evaluation dataset curation + parser/validator + dashboard hook + CI integration. Out of scope: fully automated fix suggestions and production rewrites of tool wrappers.
test_plan: 1) Curate 1,200 eval prompts covering: disambiguation, multi-tool intents, nested tool calls, edge-case args (dates, ids, long lists). 2) Implement canonical labeling format for expected tool and argument schema. 3) Run baseline evaluations against current prod model and the new model variant(s). 4) Compute metrics: top-1 tool precision, top-2 recall, argument-schema pass rate (structural), argument-semantic correctness (fuzzy match). 5) Add lightweight CI check using 200-sample quicksuite. 6) Wire alerting: Slack + PagerDuty channel with grouped failures and sample diffs.
acceptance_criteria: Automated runs generate report with metrics and persisted per-case traces
Regression alert triggers when thresholds crossed
Presubmit CI fails on P0 regressions
Console shows sample failing traces and aggregate trend charts
implementation_notes: - Use existing eval infra (ENG-9901) as runner; extend to support tool-call parsing. - Reuse model invocation harness from ENG-10135 for batched comparisons. - Validator will be a composable set of schema checks (JSONSchema + domain checkers) plus semantic checks using deterministic embedding similarity for canonical arg values. - Store artifacts in s3://redwood-evals/toolcall/eng-10458/{run_id}/. - Add minimal RBAC so only eval team can trigger full-run. - Keep runtime resource usage bounded by sharding runs across dev/nprod clusters.
risks_and_mitigations: False positives from fuzzy semantic check: tune thresholds and surface raw diffs for human review
Eval dataset bias: get sampling from production routing logs and include customer edge cases (sanitized)
Cost of continuous runs: schedule full-run nightly and incremental delta runs on commits
